title: Ingress Key Map Viewer
summary: Plot your Ingress portal keys on an interactive map by pasting your Intel inventory.
tagline: See which portal keys you can safely let go.
description: Paste the Portal Keys section of an Intel or IITC inventory export to plot your keys on an interactive map, compare key counts and filter by where they are stored.

features.title: Flexible inventory import
features.description: Accept Intel and IITC export variants from different browsers.

features.title: Key counts at a glance
features.description: Colour-code portals by the number of keys held.

features.title: Inventory and capsule filters
features.description: Show loose keys, all capsule keys or one selected capsule, with updated totals.

features.title: Private in the browser
features.description: Parse and display the inventory locally, without sending it to a server.

origin.title: A map for deciding which keys to keep.
origin.body: Other inventory apps exist, but many are aimed at planning activities. I wanted to answer a different question: which portal keys can I get rid of without affecting how I play? Plotting the inventory on a map makes duplicate keys, route coverage and gaps easier to recognise.
